statement: The Linux v6.12 hid-wiimote driver responds to probe/status/hotplug and dedicated MotionPlus evdev open/close with its own A400F0=55, A400FB=00, A600F0=55, A600FB=00, A600FA read, A400FA read and A600FE 04/05/07 map transactions, plus report-mode/status requests. This shares the same mutable extension state with Dolphin raw HIDAPI, so a kernel reconciliation can reset Dolphin's mapping or race its reads. Dolphin emits a Linux driver warning but does not veto an open, and the source does not show kernel binding to be intrinsically fatal: observed success requires per-transaction attribution, not speculation. Opening an MP evdev node sets MP_USED and schedules mapping; mere hidraw open does not.
